description: Read a site's llms.txt (the llmstxt.org convention that tells AI agents where the useful docs are), SSRF-safe: title, summary, details and every section's links (title, absolute URL, notes; "Optional" section flagged), whether llms-full.txt exists, size / token estimate and format issues. Accepts a domain or a direct URL to an llms.txt file. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/llms-txt

url.description: Domain, site URL or direct URL of an llms.txt / llms-full.txt
